schema.text: What kind of improvement do you propose?

options.text: A better street, pavement or crossing
A new or reopened connection, such as stairs or a passage
Feeling safer from theft, assault or harassment
Traffic lights: more time to cross, or a repair
A public transport stop or better public transport
A repair or maintenance, such as potholes or broken equipment
Easier access to a service or an entrance
